scope: Review fixes on top of the uncommitted milestone-three Bottosson checkpoint. No commit or push. Dualray port remains pending.
baseline_build: Frozen pre-fix source, Cargo release, RUSTFLAGS='-C target-cpu=native', separate target directory. Initial comparison against an existing on-disk executable was discarded because its hash did not match the recorded native build.

confirmed_bug.cause: Large-angle f32 degree-to-radian rounding plus cancellation in the saturation channel residual, amplified by the one-Halley cusp calculation.
confirmed_bug.fix: Only in the native-f32 cusp path within one degree of the target blue primary: rotate a small angle around 270 degrees, use fused products and compensate channel-residual cube/product/sum rounding. Retains the same fit and one Halley step. Canonical conversion and f64 saturation path unchanged; no f64 runtime fallback.

validation.dense_blue_corpus: Every positive f32 hue within +/-0.1 degree of each blue primary, plus 3001 offset samples over +/-1.1 degrees to cross the conditioning cutover, each with -360/0/+360 wrapping, ten lightnesses, C=0.4, both variants and both modes. f64 tests use the same base hues. Counts are mappings, including repeated wrapped inputs, not unique colors.
validation.oracle: Independent XYZ primary sectors and cubic-channel reconstruction with one Halley step, separate from geometric approximation quality. Checked canonical outputs are verified bit-for-bit. The existing cusp and geometric boundary tests also pass.
validation.startup_regression: The exact reported sRGB input now passes all-method startup validation, not only the isolated mapper test.

review_disposition.nan_running_max: Already guarded: finite output, deltaEOK, encoded and linear error assertions precede maximum accumulation. Existing injected-NaN/Infinity tests pass in all build configurations.
review_disposition.docs: CLI help, root README, Rust docs and stale comments updated to twelve multi-gamut methods and only Dualray remaining P3-only.
review_disposition.mode_comparison: Removed the unasserted P3 equivalence statistic. Generic validation now asserts exact plain/checked agreement when a canonical precheck rejects, and exact canonical preservation when it accepts; injected mode-mismatch tests verify enforcement. In-gamut Bottosson plain and checked outputs need not agree.
review_disposition.edge_residual_rounding: Generated residuals subtract the actual compiled LUT knot. Tests compare them to independently referenced f64/native knots. No assumption about intermediate f64-to-f32 parsing remains.
review_disposition.root_face_identity: first_face_root takes explicit upper/lower identity; zero lower bound no longer implies an upper face. Direction tests cover both faces.
review_disposition.shared_code: Shared OKLCh/Oklab pass-through and clipping helpers, one shared Edge mapping policy, one hue-bucket helper, common root helper, cancellation-free lightness blend.
review_disposition.p3_fit_layout: All three gamuts use one generated file and the same fitted! implementation. P3 coefficients remain pinned in the generator; no P3 refit.
review_disposition.edge_static_data: Sharp-interval bands computed at compile time; indexed lookup borrows a compile-time 3600-entry index, eliminating the per-instance Vec and initialization.
review_disposition.relocating_lut_knots: Intentionally not done: quantizing or moving repaired knots changes the boundary interpolation policy. Existing distinct knots and their mapping geometry are retained, with residuals tied to actual stored values.
review_disposition.earlier_findings: Near-white/tiny-root regression tests, independent geometric fold sweeps including sRGB L=0.414/h=264.0425, achromatic Raytrace tests, all-gamut cross-method checks, and dark perceptual-gate tests all pass. Linear gates remain paired with DeltaEOK gates; no universal encoded-channel bound is claimed.

compatibility.manifest: Grid + benchmark random + 32768 mixed and 32768 low-C inputs (mulberry32 0x6d756c74) + 144 endpoint/extreme-hue inputs. Every output channel serialized as native bits.
compatibility.note: Only f32 Bottosson cusp conditioning changes sampled output bits. Shared conversion cleanup, root-face API and Edge index/residual refactors preserve all sampled outputs from other methods.

assembly_audit.note: Native f32 exported wrappers for three targets, two variants and two modes; recursively inspected outlined local callees as well. No double arithmetic, double FMA or widening.

manifest.random: Independent stratified/jittered then shuffled H/L, C=0.4
manifest.precision: f64 originals, f32 rounded before timing

benchmark.checksum: All three channels widened/accumulated per sample, consumed with black_box before timer stops. Construction, cache warmup, mode/gamut dispatch outside timing.
benchmark.scope: Full P3 harness in ABBA order per mode with identical path and CPU affinity. No builds, tests or competing benchmarks during timing. Source, immutable data placement and untimed validation changed; this does not isolate the cost of any one edit.

limitations: These are sampled accuracy envelopes on this compiler/runtime, not a full-domain or cross-platform proof.
Bottosson and Edge Seeker retain their documented approximate boundary policies and blue-fold differences from first exit.
Portable builds may implement mul_add with fmaf calls; portable correctness was tested, portable timing was not measured.
Target-specific timing runs are not a balanced cross-target comparison.
